Delegate OnixEventLocalServerWorld.OnBlockChangedDelegate

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Events
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Delegate that is invoked whenever a block in the world changes. Provides context about the region, position, old and new blocks, as well as how the change should be propagated and rendered.

public delegate void OnixEventLocalServerWorld.OnBlockChangedDelegate(WorldBlocks region, BlockPos position, Block oldBlock, Block newBlock, int layer, WorldBlocks.BlockUpdateType updateType)

Parameters

region WorldBlocks

The WorldBlocks that did the change.///

position BlockPos

The BlockPos of the block that was modified.

oldBlock Block

The Block instance that previously occupied the position.

newBlock Block

The Block instance that replaced the old block.

layer int

The layer, there are two layers. 0 is the main layer, 1 is generally used for waterlogging and things snow layers merging with some plants.

updateType WorldBlocks.BlockUpdateType

A WorldBlocks.BlockUpdateType flag that specifies how the update should be handled, such as updating neighbors, notifying the network, skipping graphics updates, or forcing priority updates.
